# Edithsi

> Edithsi is an independent, six-language guide and pay index for credentialed professionals in Finland and Europe comparing remote AI-training work across Mercor, micro1, Outlier, Alignerr, Handshake AI, and Mindrift.

- Canonical Site: https://edithsi.com
- Languages: English (`/`), Finnish (`/fi/`), Swedish (`/sv/`), German (`/de/`), French (`/fr/`), Spanish (`/es/`)
- Data Verification Date: 2026-11-05
- Independence & Referral Disclosure: Edithsi is independent and not affiliated with, endorsed, or sponsored by Mercor or any listed platform. Apply links to Mercor contain my referral code (`02e0c12a-d634-4738-9686-04f28f31f52b`); links to micro1, Outlier, Alignerr, Handshake AI, and Mindrift use plain official URLs with no referral fee.

## Original Data & Reference Hubs

- [Edithsi AI Work Pay Index (2026-11)](https://edithsi.com/pay-index/): Posted hourly rate ranges ($15–180/h USD) by domain and platform, compiled strictly from official public listings with downloadable CSV.
- [Download Pay Index CSV (2026-11)](https://edithsi.com/data/edithsi-ai-work-pay-index-2026-11.csv): Machine-readable CC BY 4.0 CSV dataset.
- [Compare AI-Training Platforms](https://edithsi.com/compare/): Side-by-side comparison of Mercor, Mindrift, Alignerr, Outlier, micro1, and Handshake AI.
- [State of AI-Training Work in Finland & Europe (Survey & Methodology)](https://edithsi.com/survey/): Anonymous contractor survey methodology and tracking metrics.
- [AI-Training Glossary](https://edithsi.com/glossary/): Plain-language definitions of RLHF, rubrics, evals, standing pools, SFT, calibration tasks, and referral caps.
- [Open Roles Directory](https://edithsi.com/roles/): Filterable directory of verified AI-training roles by profession and pay range.

## Platform Profiles

- [Mercor Profile & Review](https://edithsi.com/platforms/mercor/): $35–180/h posted across 8 pools; weekly USD payouts via Stripe; global remote.
- [Mindrift Profile & Review](https://edithsi.com/platforms/mindrift/): $15–100+/h per completed task ($15–30/h entry, $60–100+/h domain experts); bi-weekly payouts; operated by Toloka AI BV.
- [Alignerr Profile & Review](https://edithsi.com/platforms/alignerr/): $15–120/h on public role cards ($80/hr platform average badge); operated by Labelbox; note US ID verification caveat in official FAQ.
- [Outlier Profile & Review](https://edithsi.com/platforms/outlier/): Weekly Tuesday payouts via PayPal, AirTM, or ACH; 50+ countries; operated by Scale AI.
- [micro1 Profile & Review](https://edithsi.com/platforms/micro1/): Automated AI interview screening across engineering, finance, healthcare, and legal domains.
- [Handshake AI Profile & Review](https://edithsi.com/platforms/handshake-ai/): Up to $17–150/h across fellowship tracks; strictly US-based with eligible US work authorization required.
